name: Choreo Planer
description: Agent interface for Choreo Planer, a free online tool for planning cheerleading and dance choreography. Create and manage clubs, teams, seasons, members, choreographies, hits, lineups and positions, and export countsheets as PDF or video.

bearer.description: JWT bearer token. See https://api.choreo-planer.de/auth.md for how to obtain one.

skills.name: Choreography management
skills.description: Create, read, update and delete choreographies, including their hits, lineups and positions, and export countsheets.
examples: Create a new choreography for my cheer team
Assign positions and counts to a lineup
Export a countsheet as PDF or video

skills.name: Team management
skills.description: Manage teams and their season assignments.

skills.name: Position management
skills.description: Manage positions of members within a lineup for each count.
